name: Changpeng Zhao (CZ)
citizenship: Canada (Forbes); born Jiangsu, China; resident Dubai, United Arab Emirates

onTheRecord.finding: Nov 21, 2023: Zhao, 'a Canadian national', pleaded guilty in W.D. Washington to failing to maintain an effective anti-money-laundering program (Bank Secrecy Act) and resigned as Binance CEO; Binance Holdings pleaded guilty and agreed to $4,316,126,163 total penalty (forfeiture $2,510,650,588 + criminal fine $1,805,475,575). DOJ release links Zhao plea agreement.
Personal $50 million fine paid by Zhao as part of the plea (per Forbes profile editor note, which also records the four-month prison term and October 2025 pardon by Donald Trump).
Apr 30, 2024: sentenced by U.S. District Judge Richard A. Jones (Seattle) to four months in prison; prosecutors had sought three years. Binance allowed >1.5M trades (~$900M) violating U.S. sanctions.

notes: No US private foundation or 990-PF found in his name (not searched exhaustively; he is a non-US person). Charitable vehicles: Giggle Academy (free K-12-style online learning platform announced by CZ in 2024). Public figures seen only via crypto trade press/search snippets (needs-check): Giggle Academy donation wallet raised ~1,311 BNB (~$1.3M) within 12 hours of opening donations (Cointelegraph); later reports of ~$11M-$11.5M BNB routed to it via GIGGLE meme-token transaction fees; CZ reportedly transferred ~$965,000 of digital assets to Giggle Academy in Aug 2026 (coinalertnews / coinokc snippets, not verified). Binance Charity is a Binance corporate arm, not a personal foundation. Political 2024: no data sought/found; as a Canadian citizen he cannot legally contribute to U.S. federal campaigns, so null.
